body.statement: For a canonical LV-SEM-ME \(M\) satisfying LV-SEM-ME rank faithfulness, \(M\) is nonminimal if and only if there are a root latent variable \(H_i\) and an mleaf child \(Z_j\) such that \(\operatorname{An}(Z_j)\subseteq\operatorname{An}(V_a)\) for every other child \(V_a\) of \(H_i\).

source.verbatim_statement: For each variable V_i in Z union Y and any pair of subsets (J,K) satisfying either stated condition, the rank of the submatrix W^J_{K union {V_i}} is equal to the size of a minimal bottleneck from J to K union {V_i}. Under conventional faithfulness, a linear LV-SEM-ME is not minimal if and only if there exists an unobserved variable H_i and an mleaf child Z_j of H_i such that, for any other child V_k of H_i, An(Z_j) is a subset of An(V_k).
